title: Current qualification baseline
summary: SMTP Secure Stack v0.1-dev11 remains the last complete qualified implementation baseline under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196. Current Git source is dev7.3: dev7.1 closes post-final-DATA cleanup retry ambiguity, dev7.2 adds restart-safe storage commits and mailbox enumeration, and dev7.3 makes restart recovery fail closed on orphaned/corrupt catalogue or metadata state. Autobuilder is not running, so no fresh dev7.3 runtime qualification is claimed.
invariants: Complete SMTP policy, S/MIME, MAS/MAIL, wire, durable-delivery, outbound-dispatch, STARTTLS, Socket Provider, RPC-over-SMTP and instrumentation regression suite passed.
Mandatory dev11 source classes compile with rexxc under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
Claude ooRexx standards enforcer reported 0 errors and PASS; remaining warnings are non-fatal heuristics.
Live IPv6 was not claimed because the rxSock6 socket6.cls runtime dependency was not present in the qualification environment.
The package documents newer estate component heads separately when exact executable archives were unavailable; it does not falsely claim execution against those unavailable heads.
Current Git dev7.1 adds a regression for QUIT/close syntax exceptions after final DATA 250; the fix is source-committed while dev11 remains the last full executable qualification.
Current Git dev7.2 adds atomic recovery metadata/catalogue commit and a restart mailbox reload regression; it is committed source evidence only while autobuilder is stopped.
Current Git dev7.3 rejects orphaned message bodies, catalogue size mismatches, short reads and missing/incomplete recovery metadata; this remains source evidence until autobuilder resumes.
